Historical full-card image of [[Where Are Those Droidekas?! (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational) (Original)|Where Are Those Droidekas?!]], matching the [[Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
